dogecoin.text: @WSB_Degenerate @joekreate @ChrisRandone Because you literally said it was only Dogecoin miners making money. That’s straight up wrong.

Love or hate Elon Musk, any currency becomes legitimized once it becomes based on the value of labor, as opposed to gold, silver, or any other standard.

By accepting $BTC and $DOGE, the two coins become more legitimate. It’s hard to be bearish when such is the case.
